read_optical_flow: read optical flow data from a .flo file and return U and V displacement arrays
write_optical_flow: write U and V optical flow arrays to a .flo binary file on disk
read_depth: read depth map data from a binary .depth file and return as a numpy array
write_disparity: write a disparity map to a PNG file with 16 or 32 bit depth encoding
read_camera_matrices: read intrinsic and extrinsic camera matrices from a binary .cam file
